usage: Ngau4 paak3 jip6 (beef tripe) is commonly used as an ingredient in dim sum and Cantonese soups.
The word 'ngau4 paak3 jip6' functions as a noun referring to the edible stomach lining of a cow.
You can use 'ngau4 paak3 jip6' to specify a particular type of offal when ordering food.
It often appears after the quantifier when counting portions, for example, 'yat1 go3 ngau4 paak3 jip6' means 'one serving of beef tripe'.
